answer: Divergent challenge mechanism. Each identity must answer a fresh random challenge derived from a shared seed, and answers must match on a slow public violet channel while differing on a fast private one. A clone farm cannot diverge because all copies share the same key and history, so its replies arrive with a detectable pulse signature that flags the cluster. Yarrow-seeded nonces make each round unguessable, forcing an attacker to buy a distinct key and history per identity at the full cost of real participation.
